top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks are a verified discovery rather than an elegant idea: the magic-wavelength lattice removes light and motional shifts for thousands of neutral atoms at once, which took clocks to the 1e-18 level and has been reproduced independently at JILA, RIKEN/Tokyo, PTB, NIST and SYRTE. The allocation to Katori (proposal and first realization) and Ye (record accuracy and many-body control) is clean and unanimously supported, and the citation is well scoped, so awarding it is clearly preferable to no award.
